sources.title: Data sources
sources.hint: Official feeds only use verified public URLs. Physiology bands are demo policy — no invented papers.
sources.thresholdsHint: Built-in demo clinical policy for AURA and role homes. Not a NASA-certified protocol and not bound to a verified OSDR/NTRS paper.

noaa.used: G/R/S scale mapping (Kp, GOES X-ray peak, ≥10 MeV protons)
noaa.note: Verified public URL. R-scale: M1=R1, M5=R2, X1=R3, X10=R4, X20=R5; C-class is R0.

xray.used: Live long-wave X-ray flux and GOES class
xray.note: Verified public URL. Empty and timeout stay empty/timeout; nothing is interpolated.

proton.note: Verified public URL. The demo SPE scenario is labeled separately and never overwrite as official.

donki.used: Flare / geomagnetic storm / CME event catalog
donki.note: Verified public URL. Timeout and empty window are labeled separately: timeout ≠ confirmed no events.

osdr.used: Public astronaut health and life-science data portal
osdr.note: Verified public URL. Demo thresholds are not bound to a single OSDR study DOI.

ntrs.note: Verified public URL. Unverified report numbers or titles are not cited.

analysis.overallCritical: One or more physiology metrics are in the critical band. Take countermeasures and notify the ground.
analysis.overallCaution: Overall caution: some metrics are off the demo band, not immediately critical.
analysis.overallNormal: Overall normal. Mission fitness is acceptable.
analysis.hrCritical: Resting HR {value} exceeds the microgravity demo critical band (>100 bpm). May relate to fluid shift, autonomic imbalance, or dehydration.
analysis.hrCaution: Resting HR {value} is above the orbital demo ideal (50–90 bpm), not yet critical tachycardia.
analysis.hrNormal: Resting HR {value} is in the demo normal band.
analysis.hrvCritical: HRV {value}: severe autonomic suppression (<20 ms). May relate to sleep debt, overtraining, or load.
analysis.hrvCaution: HRV {value} is below ideal (≥25 ms); recovery is reduced.
analysis.spo2Critical: SpO₂ {value} is below the cabin demo critical band (<94%). Check ECLSS O₂/CO₂.
analysis.spo2Caution: SpO₂ {value} is slightly below demo ideal (≥96%).
analysis.vo2Off: VO₂ max {value}: aerobic reserve is low; microgravity can accelerate deconditioning.
analysis.vo2Ok: VO₂ max {value}: aerobic baseline is acceptable.
analysis.sleepOff: Average sleep {value} is under the 7-hour demo target and may affect cognition and HRV recovery.
analysis.sleepOk: Average sleep {value} meets the demo recovery target.
analysis.exOff: Exercise countermeasure {value} is off the ISS-informed demo prescription (~90–210 min).
analysis.exOk: Exercise countermeasure {value} matches the demo prescription band.

rec.noPeakSpo2: Avoid peak exercise while SpO₂ is low
rec.noAerobicTachy: Do not add aerobic load during tachycardia
rec.restDay: If excess, convert to a recovery day
rec.hydrateLog: Run fluids and lower peak load
rec.logGround: Log the anomaly for the ground flight surgeon
rec.syncLoad: Sync load with the flight surgeon
rec.aredLoad: Check ARED load and pain reports

reason.allNormal: All demo threshold bands are Normal.

toast.noteLogged: Clinical note written to today’s health record

sys.cardioOk: Cardiovascular adaptation is good; resting HR and HRV are in the demo bands.
sys.cardioOff: Cardiovascular stress of microgravity: heart rate and/or HRV is off the demo band.
sys.respOff: SpO₂ is low; check cabin gas and activity load.
sys.sleepOk: Sleep hours meet the recovery target.
sys.sleepOff: Sleep debt may weaken cognition and HRV recovery.
sys.exOk: Exercise countermeasure matches the demo prescription.
sys.exOff: Exercise hours are off prescription; adjust with cardiovascular status.
sys.mentalOff: Mental status is marked “{value}”; read with sleep and timeline load.
